risk: Message payload loss during exception handling in SubProcess_91
consequence: If CallActivity_4 fails before setting 'InputPayload' property, CallActivity_97 reads null, causing Log_Payload to log empty data and obscuring root cause analysis.
mitigation: Unit tests assert that CallActivity_4 sets ${in.body} into property.InputPayload immediately at process start, and test_exception_subprocess_execution verifies payload restoration.

risk: Silent message termination without alerting on routing escalation
consequence: Messages meeting neither SalesOrder nor SO Return criteria route to EndEvent_11 (EscalationEndEvent); without monitoring on EscalationCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet', order drops unnoticed.
mitigation: Scenario SCN-GLOVIA-003 and test_default_route_escalation validate that the escalation error code is explicitly emitted and HTTP status/alerts are captured.

risk: Orphaned or unlinked activities (CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86)
consequence: The BPMN definitions contain CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck) and CallActivity_86 (XPath extraction) outside normal sequence flows, risking dead code deployment and logic drift.
mitigation: Unit test suite verifies routing conditions against known code sets ('YORB', 'YICB', 'POR', 'MNZ', 'PLM') directly and highlights unlinked activities in coverage reporting.

risk: SOAP sender adapter parameter mismatches and security exceptions
consequence: The inbound SOAP adapter specifies WSSecurity 'VerifyMessage' with SHA1 and RoleBased auth. Inbound requests with missing signatures or unauthorized roles are rejected at runtime.
mitigation: Integration contract tests mock SOAP security verification headers and simulate auth boundaries prior to downstream execution.
